records.observation: After package materialization, hardcoded README surface expectations and FZ-MASTER-TRACEABILITY.md lagged registry.mjs, so local/CI Verify failed on main repeatedly.
evidence: scripts/readme/regions.test.mjs expected admin not-built while apps/admin/package.json exists since 582e4e6
scripts/requirements/registry.test.mjs asserted FZ-MASTER-TRACEABILITY.md equals renderMarkdown from registry.mjs
commit 675dc3d earlier fixed portal surface drift then admin materialization regressed the same class
GitHub Actions run 35776765562 Verify Test failed on HEAD 330a514
scripts/ci/pre-push-gate.mjs and scripts/ci/push-main.mjs enforce Verify-equivalent checks before safe push
scripts/fz-noc/policy.mjs classifyShell denies direct git push and --no-verify; force remains DANGEROUS
scripts/ci/pre-push-gate.test.mjs covers gate fail, push refuse, HEAD mutation, wrong branch, and shell bypass cases
records.hypothesis: Materializing an apps package or changing registry.mjs without refreshing projection tests and FZ-MASTER-TRACEABILITY.md leaves main red; a deterministic local gate would catch that before push.
records.proposedImprovement: Require the same local deterministic checks that CI runs (including README surface snapshot and registry projection equality) before any fast-forward push to origin main.
records.validationMethod: Deterministic scripts/ci/pre-push-gate.mjs plus Cursor shell deny of direct git push and pnpm push:main wrapper with unit bypass tests

effectPlan.successSignal: Canonical pre-push gate and push-main refuse when projection/readme checks fail before transport push
effectPlan.failureSignal: Known projection-drift class reaches origin/main CI or push proceeds despite local failure

evidence: replay:runPrePushGate fails on pnpm readme:check for projection drift class
replay:runPushMain returns gate_failed with pushed=false and no transport push

records.result: Deterministic isolated replay: gate fails on readme projection drift and push-main refuses transport push.
